newsitem.title: UK: Rexam says first 3 months start promisingly.
newsitem.headline: Rexam says first 3 months start promisingly.

text.p: Packaging group Rexam Plc said on Wednesday that trading in the first three months of the year has started "promisingly".

The group also announced that it is reorganising its food and beverage sector, with the result that Metallised Papers US will become part of the coated films and papers sector, while Rexam Flexible Packaging Lakeville will be in the healthcare sector.

Kevin Abbott, the director responsible for food and beverage packaging, is leaving the company with immediate effect, the company said in a statement. Rolf Borjesson will assume the role of acting sector director.
"I believe this reorganisation is an important step which enables the sector to focus on those niches with potential," Borjesson said.
The company also announced that it has sold its 50 percent stake in Blowmocan Holdings Ltd to Nampak Ltd, the other joint venture shareholder, for 2.0 million stg.
